title: Creature FX gallery
hypothesis: Placeholder silhouettes plus layered FX (emissive, particles, trails, light, fog, restrained bloom) are enough to judge each creature concept's readability goal before any real art or AI exists.
success_signals: All four concept placeholders render side by side at player-relative scale.
Each profile exposes at least one deterministic FX state switchable from a test hook.
Every FX layer can be disabled individually to compare readability and performance.
kill_criteria: FX layers cannot be judged because the placeholder silhouettes are unreadable.
State switching is non-deterministic or crashes the runtime.
reset_strategy: Destroy the gallery root entity, clear trails and global fog/post state, and rebuild every pedestal from the concept profiles. No backend state involved.
